title: Derivative of the radial cutoff mass t -> integral phi(|x - y|/t) dmu (Simon Ch. 4, 4.3)
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), 0 < T → μ (closedBall y S) < ⊤ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → (∀ u : ℝ, T ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → Integrable (fun x => φ (‖x - y‖ / t)) μ ∧ Integrable (fun x => ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t)) μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) ∂μ) (-(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) ∂μ) / t) t
